_meta.description: The Thane Integral Ring Metro's 22 stations in MahaMetro's order, from Raila Devi round the ring to New Thane; after New Thane the line runs back to Raila Devi. 'kml_name' is the station's point in the project's official map file (Google My Maps, embedded on thanemetrorail.com/route-map). Positions and along_m come from scripts/build-alignment-thane-ring.py. Names follow MahaMetro's route map page, except where its tenders or map file differ (see each station's notes). MahaMetro has published no Marathi station names.

location.method: The project's official route map (Google My Maps, on thanemetrorail.com/route-map): point "RAILA DEVI". along_m is measured along the map's centre line (PROPOSED_CL) from Raila Devi, in the order of MahaMetro's list; the point is 29 m from that line.

interchanges.notes: housing.com (Nov 2025) lists an interchange with Line 4 here. On the ring's official map file the nearest Line 4 station, RTO Thane, is about 0.8 km away. Neither project calls the two an interchange.

context.text: The first station on MahaMetro's list, where the tunnel from New Thane comes up to the viaduct. Soil testing had reached Raila Devi by Sep 2026, reported as the start of phase 1.

construction_status.notes: Station design tender T1-030/DDC-04/2026; no construction contract was found. Piling for the viaduct began in Nov 2026 (reported).
